sourceBoundary: Targeted October 14-18 oncology surveillance. Dated ClinicalTrials.gov-derived mirrors provide transitions and results. Direct official ClinicalTrials.gov API/version reconciliation and global ICTRP/CTIS/ChiCTR completeness not established. No patient-specific clinical decisions or notifications from raw research evidence.

studies.name: IOV-PED-101 — Autologous tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte therapy in pediatric/AYA solid tumors
studies.molecularEligibility: No required tumor genomic variant identified; relapsed/refractory solid tumor and resectable lesion for TIL generation; age range 6 months–21 years (weight at least 8 kg).
studies.finding: Registry-derived version history records active/not recruiting to terminated; sponsor decided to conclude remaining participant visits after reviewing available safety and efficacy data. 5 actual participants versus 40 previously planned.
studies.limitations: Specific adverse events, efficacy failure, or safety causality have not been disclosed; do not infer these from the sponsor's broad rationale.
studies.action: Exclude from study enrollment matching; preserve termination reason verbatim and monitor any final results.

studies.name: DIT309T-IS001 — DIT309 CAR-T in advanced bone and soft tissue sarcoma
studies.molecularEligibility: Protocol-defined positive tumor target-antigen expression required; a prior secondary mirror names B7-H3 IHC >=20%, but latest dated registry mirror only states target-antigen positivity, so exact threshold requires reconciliation.
biomarkers: Protocol-defined tumor antigen positive by tissue test
institutions: Shanghai General Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine
endpoints: Maximum tolerated dose / recommended Phase 2 dose
studies.finding: Recruiting -> Suspended in the October 14 ClinicalTrials.gov-derived change record; sponsor reason: 'Data update in progress.'
studies.limitations: Administrative reason given; there is no confirmed safety signal or clinical hold cause. Inconsistent age criterion (structured 8 years vs free text 8 weeks) should be reconciled.
studies.action: Suspend clinical-trial matching for this study; check future registry/sponsor update for restart and reconcile target-antigen requirement.

studies.name: NKTR-255 following CD19 CAR-T in relapsed/refractory LBCL
cancer: Relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma
studies.molecularEligibility: Prior CD19-directed CAR-T treatment (axi-cel or liso-cel) required; no universal somatic mutation specified.
interventions: NKTR-255 (IL-15 receptor agonist), three stage-1 dose groups
institutions: University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center
endpoints: Month-6 complete response by blinded independent central review (primary)
studies.status: TERMINATED (previously; not a new status change)
studies.finding: First posted results show 15 Stage 1 participants; 8/11 NKTR-255-assigned participants and 2/4 placebo-assigned participants listed with complete response at 6 months. Stage 2 never enrolled; trial termination was a prior event.
studies.limitations: Extremely small, early-ended multi-dose Stage 1; observed counts are descriptive, not proof of efficacy or a statistically supported comparison. Do not label termination as a new Oct 16 change.
studies.action: Store posted results as a descriptive evidence update with small-sample and early-termination flags; retain protocol outcome definitions.

studies.name: PANGU-1 — JMBI-001 in MYC-positive solid tumors and NHL
studies.molecularEligibility: Except Phase Ia accelerated titration, MYC-positive nuclei by immunohistochemistry: >=10% in solid tumors and >=40% in non-Hodgkin lymphoma; age 18–75. Biomarker is protein expression, not proof of MYC gene mutation.
endpoints: Phase Ia dose-limiting toxicity, maximum tolerated dose, recommended expansion dose
studies.status: RECRUITING (registry-history mirror October 15; primary-search snapshot October 8 was not yet recruiting)
studies.finding: New MYC-expression-defined Phase 1/2 study first posted Oct 8; Oct 15 registry-history mirror records transition to Recruiting and first Beijing site added. Secondary registry identifier CTR20263562 is in ClinicalTrials.gov metadata.
studies.limitations: The directly indexed primary registry excerpt predates the recruitment transition. Confirm the current primary record and site contact before using for enrollment matching.
studies.action: Register MYC IHC-stratified research cohort and China CDE cross-identifier; mark site enrollment provisional pending direct primary-record refresh.
